profile.name: Mishkaat Yousuf
profile.headline: Computer Science Graduate | Software Engineering & AI
profile.summary: Full Stack Developer and Software Engineer experienced in building RESTful APIs, full-stack web applications, and AI/ML systems using React.js, Node.js, Python, and Docker. Skilled in database integration, automated testing, code quality, and AI-powered workflows.

education.details: CGPA: 3.71/4.0. Achieved Rector’s List & Gold Medal in Fall 2025 and Spring 2026. Dean’s List for 5 consecutive semesters (Spring 2023 - Spring 2025). Relevant Courses: Database Systems, Data Science, Data Structures & Algorithms, Object-Oriented Programming, Operating Systems, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning, Agile Software Project Management, Recommender Systems, Information Security.

experience.details: Built RESTful backend services with Node.js and Express. Implemented CRUD APIs, database persistence, input validation, custom health checks, and Swagger documentation. Containerized PostgreSQL database infrastructure using Docker and managed connections via environment variables.

Developed full-stack web applications using React.js, Node.js, RESTful APIs, and MySQL. Configured application logging and automated test suites using Pino Logger, Mocha, and Jest. Used SonarQube static analysis to maximize code quality and collaborated using Git version control.

projects.title: Backend CRUD API Task Manager
projects.summary: A RESTful Task Management API built with Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL featuring automatic seeding and containerization.
projects.details: Built a persistent RESTful backend supporting complete task CRUD operations. Containerized the entire infrastructure stack using Docker and Docker Compose with database auto-initialization and seeding. Includes integrated Swagger UI documentation. Data persists reliably via localized Docker volumes.
projects.evidence: Supports clean local endpoints at port 3000 with fully interactive Swagger documentation generated via openapi.json schemas.

projects.title: Electronic Logging Device (ELD) Trip Planner
projects.summary: Full-stack application for truck drivers that maps optimal driving routes and auto-generates regulatory HOS log sheets.
projects.details: Engineered a complex Hours-of-Service (HOS) simulation module in Python following strict FMCSA transportation safety rules. Calculates optimal driving limits, mandatory breaks, and rest periods based on truck cycle histories. Renders visual map paths, geocoded stops, and custom daily step-line ELD grids directly on the frontend UI.
projects.evidence: Monitored via interactive MapView and live SVG log grids representing 24-hour schedules.

projects.title: AI Portfolio Guide Agent
projects.summary: A portfolio-grounded RAG conversational AI assistant capable of reasoning over local resume data using tool calls.
projects.details: Developed an active agent utilizing Google Gen AI SDK tool integrations. Intercepts natural language questions from recruiters, invokes a localized keyword search over structured document bases, and passes contextual evidence vectors into Gemini models to output grounded, hallucination-free answers.
projects.evidence: Utilizes server-side execution configurations combined with automated schema declarations to enforce zero informational inventions.

projects.title: FinSight AI: Automated Financial Close System
projects.summary: Enterprise agentic platform automating book audits and financial close cycles through invoice parsing, ledger reconciliation, and AI workflows.
projects.details: Final Year Capstone Project implementing microservices across React, NestJS, and FastAPI. Automates compliance workflows like invoice processing with OCR, ledger reconciliation, and report assembly. Hardened with Argon2 security, AES-256 data-at-rest encryption, and infrastructure observation pipelines via Prometheus and Grafana dashboards.
projects.evidence: Provisioned on AWS cloud environments with Infrastructure as Code configurations via HashiCorp Terraform modules.
